mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 130 Octa engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full rebuilt Land Rover Defender 130 Octa engine typically costs between £15,000 and £22,000 for supply only. Reconditioned units start around £12,000, while used engines can be found from £8,000. Prices vary based on whether you choose supply-only or a full supply and fit service.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of turbo or cooling system failure in a Land Rover Defender 130 Octa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Early warning signs include unusual whining noises from the turbochargers, minor coolant seepage, or intermittent boost irregularities. You might also experience engine management lights related to the 48V mild-hybrid system or thermal management.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 130 Octa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, given the current ultra-premium vehicle market. A well-maintained Land Rover Defender 130 Octa holds a value of £130,000 to £160,000+. Investing £15,000-£22,000 in a rebuilt engine with a 12-month warranty is financially viable and protects the appreciating asset value of this exclusive high-performance 4x4.

mainEntity.name: What is the engine configuration for the Land Rover Defender 130 Octa?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Land Rover Defender 130 Octa is powered by a 4.4-litre twin-turbocharged V8 mild-hybrid engine, producing 635PS. It features advanced direct injection, a 48V electrical system for torque fill and efficiency, and sophisticated thermal management systems designed for extreme performance.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 130 Octa engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Land Rover Defender 130 Octa typically takes 3 to 5 working days due to the complexity of the V8 installation, mild-hybrid systems, and ancillary components. This includes removal, thorough cleaning, installation, and comprehensive software calibration.
